I see the bug! In `pixAverageRasterScans`, the condition `if (nscans <= h)` is wrong. When `nscans <= h`, it should use `nscans` scans centered vertically, but instead it sets `first = 0` and `last = h - 1` (using all rows). The else branch (when `nscans > h`) correctly centers the scans. But the real issue is that when `nscans <= h`, it should center the scans, not use all rows.

Wait, let me re-read more carefully. The condition is inverted. When `nscans <= h`, it should center `nscans` rows. When `nscans > h`, it should use all rows. But the code does the opposite.
